segments.name: Las Chispas
segments.description: Underground silver-gold mine in Sonora, Mexico, acquired in early 2025, producing precious metals doré.
segments.evidence: The Las Chispas underground silver-gold mine, located in the State of Sonora in northern Mexico, which began operations in 2022 and was acquired by Coeur in early 2025.

segments.name: Palmarejo
segments.description: Silver-gold complex in Chihuahua, Mexico, producing precious metals doré since 2009.
segments.evidence: The Palmarejo silver-gold complex, located in the State of Chihuahua in northern Mexico, which has been in operation since 2009.

segments.name: Rochester
segments.description: Open pit heap leach silver-gold mine in northwestern Nevada, expanded in 2024.
segments.evidence: The Rochester open pit heap leach silver-gold mine, located in northwestern Nevada, which has been in operation since 1986 and completed a significant expansion in 2024.

segments.name: Kensington
segments.description: Underground gold mine near Juneau, Alaska, selling gold concentrate under a long-term offtake agreement.
segments.evidence: The Kensington underground gold mine, located north of Juneau, Alaska, which began operations in 2010.

segments.name: Wharf
segments.description: Open pit heap leach gold mine near Lead, South Dakota, producing electrolytic cathodic sludge refined into bullion.
segments.evidence: The Wharf open pit heap leach gold mine, located near Lead, South Dakota, which began operations in 1982.

segments.name: Silvertip
segments.description: Underground silver-zinc-lead exploration project in northern British Columbia, Canada.
segments.evidence: The Silvertip exploration project is engaged in the discovery of silver, zinc, lead, and other related metals.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Includes certain mineral interests, strategic equity investments, corporate office, and eliminations of intersegment transactions.
segments.evidence: " Other " includes certain mineral interests, strategic equity investments, corporate office, elimination of intersegment transactions, and other items necessary to reconcile to consolidated amounts.

revenueModel.text: The company sells refined gold and silver bullion to multi-national banks, bullion trading houses, and refiners, and sells Kensington gold concentrate to third-party smelters under a long-term offtake agreement.
revenueModel.evidence: We then sell gold and silver bullion to multi-national banks, bullion trading houses, and refiners across the globe.

changes.text: In 2025, Coeur acquired the Las Chispas mine through the SilverCrest Transaction, adding it as a new operating segment.
changes.evidence: The Las Chispas underground silver-gold mine, located in the State of Sonora in northern Mexico, which began operations in 2022 and was acquired by Coeur in early 2025.

changes.text: In 2025, Coeur agreed to acquire New Gold Inc., expected to close in 2026 and add the New Afton and Rainy River mines.
changes.evidence: The New Gold Transaction is anticipated to close in the first half of 2026, subject to relevant regulatory approvals and routine closing conditions.
